name: Watchtower
summary: Watches your Automaton server and emails you once when something needs attention, with a mute link.
description: Watchtower runs watchers on a schedule and turns what they find into alerts: one email per problem while it lasts, a Mute 24h link in every email, and a page with active alerts and their history. Emails through the server (permission notify:email). This first version ships the shared engine and a dummy watcher; real watchers come in later releases.

application.description: Watches your Automaton server and emails you once when something needs attention, with a mute link.

arguments: python -m py_compile main.py watchtower.py && mkdir -p dist/ui && cp main.py watchtower.py index.html watchtower.css dist/ && cp ui/app.css ui/app.js dist/ui/

settings.name: CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS
settings.description: How often the scheduler looks for watchers that are due (5 to 3600 seconds)

settings.name: EMAIL_TO
settings.description: Who gets alert emails (needs the notify:email permission approved): administrators, owner, project or an address an administrator allowed; separate several with commas

settings.name: PUBLIC_URL
settings.description: The address people open this app at, without a trailing slash. Alert emails carry a Mute link built from it; empty: no link, mute from the page

secrets.name: ADMIN_TOKEN
secrets.description: Password for the Watchtower page: at least 16 random characters. Without it the page and API stay locked
